quality.scope: Actual pure picking helper and actual renderer code with a WebGL uniform/event fixture. Independent homogeneous clipping and triangle-depth reference, actual Float32 uniform payloads, simulated pointer/capture/resize lifecycle. This is geometric view quality, not real GPU raster edge/depth parity, browser pixels, native/device/install or author/Save execution.

extremeFrame.scope: Actual pure framing and picking with Float32 matrix payloads derived in the renderer coordinate convention. Eighteen combinations of distant coordinates, minimum/maximum/anisotropic size, FOV and canvas aspect; guaranteed center hit and finite temporary camera. No actual GPU, browser/device pixels or source mutation.

details.scope: Read-only geometric canvas picking and renderer gesture ownership; no author/source/schema/native/backend mutation. Real browser/GPU-pixel and packaged execution proof are reported separately by the parent.

contract.surfaceSelection: Inverse near(-1)/middle(0) ray; transformed unit-box entry/exit real surfaces; homogeneous clip; minimum projected depth, later declaration wins exact equal depth matching existing LEQUAL.
contract.ownership: Renderer emits selection or focus hint only. UI owns selection approval and calls existing focusObject; renderer does not focus or change author source during hitTest/callback.
contract.gestures: Primary left single-pointer. Maximum displacement greater than 4 CSS px starts orbit and permanently removes tap eligibility for that gesture. Secondary pointer, cancel, unexpected lost capture, wheel, resize, model/reset/focus/context loss/dispose invalidate pending view gestures.
contract.normalCaptureLoss: Expected pointerup-driven release/lostpointercapture preserves qualified recent tap, including the native double-click sequence; active unexpected loss cancels.
contract.framePosition: Current CSS left/top are used with the same drawn Float32 matrices after ordinary scrolling without redraw. Changed CSS size or drawing allocation needs a fresh frame. Position changes during an active gesture or between approved tap and dblclick cancel that gesture.
contract.invalid: Missing/contextlost/disposed/unrendered/invalid matrix or coordinates return null and do not forward a callback.

limitations: CPU geometric selection from actual Float32 upload coefficients; no claim of GPU raster edge, anti-aliasing or quantized depth-buffer bit parity.
WebGL fixtures observe actual renderer uniform payloads and lifecycle calls; browser pixel/device execution requires the separate parent/UI proof.
No source-writing authority or native scene validation is introduced by this view-only frame DTO.

contracts: The pure hit helper consumes geometry and uploaded matrix payloads; it does not parse or mutate source.
Picking uses the current CSS client rect with the actual last-drawn allocation, floating origin and Float32 matrices.
Only actual box entry/exit surfaces inside the clip volume can win; near clipping never invents a cap. Exact equal depth chooses the later declaration under LEQUAL.
Single click selects a stable UUID. Native double-click may invoke the existing temporary focus; misses retain selection and filter.

Drag/cancel/other pointer/unexpected capture loss/resize/wheel/model replacement/context loss/dispose revoke click or double-click eligibility. Expected pointerup release/capture loss preserves a qualified recent tap for native double-click.
Position-only scrolling remaps current CSS coordinates without a redraw. Movement during an ongoing gesture or between its approved tap and double-click revokes that old gesture owner.
The preview validates current renderer/canvas/model membership and active source path without adding any source write or Save port.
Last-valid visual selection and focus remain available after the token changes; source location retains its stricter exact-snapshot owner guard.

resolvedFindings.finding: A secondary pointer was ignored and left the first pointer click and old tap eligible.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Other-pointer/button down cancels gesture and tap; repaired independent proof passes.

resolvedFindings.finding: Position-only scrolling incorrectly invalidated every hit until a redraw.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Current CSS position remaps the unchanged frame; ongoing and saved gestures bind position and cancel across movement.

limitations: Geometric visible-face selection is not antialias-edge or hardware depth-buffer quantization parity.
Independent renderer proof uses a WebGL uniform/event fixture; browser evidence is separately bound and is not installed/device acceptance.
Flat boxes only; no hierarchy/material/assets/new schema/native semantics/backend or authoring authority change.
Prepared isolated VM proves portability, not hostile-code sandboxing. All earlier reports and failures remain immutable.
